regime_context: The detector shows a broad rotation (70% eligible themes) with Memory, HBM & Storage as the leader but exhibiting fading momentum (val_state fading, low breadth, mixed trend). The only validated edge is the absolute-trend gate for drawdown control; several themes carry durable, broad trends (Cybersecurity, Financials, Managed Care) but crowding flags on Cyber and Managed Care warrant sizing caution. No single narrative dominates.
emerging_watch: Memory, HBM & Storage leadership under pressure: monitor for durability breach (<0.5) and rotation confirmation to Cybersecurity (challenger). Kill-criterion: if Memory's durability_bar moves above 0.7 and breadth turns positive, the watch is removed.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity exhibits strong absolute-trend credentials (durability_bar 0.9, hurst_tag trend, breadth 1.0) that the validated gate supports for risk control. Crowding (z=2.22) is a size-down flag, not a fade. Directional overweight leans on trend health while acknowledging crowding through position restraint.
evidence: crowding_z 2.22 – size caution, not a sell signal
theses.dissent: Crowding in a thematic ETF may signal performance-chasing inflows, but does not forecast near-term drawdown; the absolute-trend gate exit is the true risk.

falsifier.text: If durability_bar drops below 0.7 or breadth falls below 0.7, the overweight premise is invalidated.

theses.subject: Financials (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Financials show a durable, broad uptrend (durability 0.83, trend-tag, breadth 0.895) without crowding (z=0.73). The absolute-trend gate supports risk-controlled exposure; this is one of the healthiest trend profiles in the eligible universe.
theses.dissent: A sudden rate shock or credit event could reverse financials quickly, and the trend gate would then force an exit—but the current reading does not anticipate such a shift.

falsifier.text: If durability drops below 0.7 or breadth contracts below 0.7, the overweight call is wrong.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infrastructure has marginal trend health (durability 0.53, mixed hurst, breadth only 0.167) and is crowded (z=1.1). The absolute-trend gate suggests high risk of disqualification soon; an underweight reflects vulnerability to trend deterioration.
evidence: crowded true – sizing caution, but direction still underweight due to poor trend health
theses.dissent: A new AI capex catalyst could reignite the theme, but the detector’s internal trend metrics are historically reliable for drawdown avoidance; no prediction of a recovery is made.

falsifier.text: If durability_bar rises above 0.7 and breadth expands above 0.5, the underweight thesis is falsified.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
